0.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_TALK_ACTOR
0.description: It is both an honor and a privilege to welcome you to the Manderville Gold Saucer. If there is anything at all you would know about our facilities, you need but say the word.

4.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_A1_7
4.description: Tell me about Lord of Verminion.

8.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_A1_5
8.description: Tell me about Gold Saucer events.

10.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_CRACE
10.description: Saddle up atop a majestic bird and go roaring down the turf, that you might see your feathered friend crowned the fleetest in all of Eorzea! Chocobo racing─or “the sport of sultans,” as some have taken to calling it─is an experience like none other.

11.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_CRACE_001
11.description: But why take my word for it when you can experience the thrills of chocobo racing for yourself? Simply ride the Chocobo Lift located west of here to Chocobo Square, and register your bird at the reception desk within.

12.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_TRIPLETRIAD
12.description: You and an opponent locked in single combat─the five cards in your hand your sole weapon, and your wits alone to guide you to victory or defeat. This is Triple Triad, the gaming phenomenon that's swept Eorzea!

13.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_TRIPLETRIAD_001
13.description: But words alone cannot hope to capture the excitement of the duel. So why delay? Venture southwest to Card Square, procure yourself a deck, and venture into the world of Triple Triad for yourself!

14.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_EMJ_000_000
14.description: Doman mahjong is an incredibly sophisticated contest of wits and cunning! Four players race to gather tiles and form a winning combination, all the while trying not to hand victory to their opponents. There's nothing else quite like it!

15.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_EMJ_000_001
15.description: To participate in this game of skill and strategy, head to the Manderville Tables on the second floor of Wonder Square.

16.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_LOTTERY_000_000
16.description: The Cactpot comes in two varieties, Mini and Jumbo. The principle is similar: both involve the simple act of purchasing a ticket─a ticket which has the potential to yield a fortune of MGP.

17.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_LOTTERY_000_001
17.description: The Mini Cactpot is perfect for casual players, and can be entered at any time right here at the Main Counter. Those looking to make a killing may prefer the Jumbo Cactpot, for which tickets may be purchased at the Cactpot Board on the second floor of Event Square.

18.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_LOTTERY_000_002
18.description: That said, both the Mini and Jumbo Cactpot have the potential to be highly lucrative, so we encourage you to enter early and often. As we like to say about the Cactpot, you must needs be in it to win it!

19.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_ARCADE
19.description: The halls of the Gold Saucer are lined with a wide assortment of amusements. Not merely light-hearted diversions from your daily troubles, play with skill and these attractions will also put MGP in your coinpurse! Try them all─you're sure to find more than a few that strike your fancy!

20.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_GATE
20.description: The Gold Saucer plays host to manifold and multifarious events, all with one thing in common: you, dear customer, are not merely an onlooker, but a vital part of the show! You never know when or where one will start up right around you, so stay ever on the lookout.

21.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_GATE_SYSTEM_000
21.description: Gold Saucer Active Time Events, or <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>GATEs<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, are audience-participatory events staged within the halls of the Gold Saucer.

22.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_GATE_SYSTEM_001
22.description: GATEs in progress will be indicated with a map icon. Should you wish to participate in the event, seek out and speak with the GATE client nearby.

23.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_GATE_SYSTEM_002
23.description: You can also speak with the GATE Keepers located throughout the Gold Saucer, who will guide you directly to the location of the next scheduled event.

35.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_GATE_0_1
35.description: There is never a dull moment here at the Gold Saucer. No matter the time of day, you are certain to find an event that catches your fancy.

36.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_GATE_0_SYSYEM_1
36.description: The following GATEs are held every hour, on the hour (Earth Time):<hex:02100103>Cliffanger, Leap of Faith, and Air Force One (The Cieldalaes).

37.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_GATE_0_SYSYEM_2
37.description: The following GATEs are held hourly, <hex:020703E80203><hex:022402DA03> minutes past the hour (Earth Time):<hex:02100103>The Slice Is Right, Any Way the Wind Blows, and Air Force One (The Gold Saucer).

38.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_GATE_0_SYSYEM_3
38.description: The following GATEs are held hourly, <hex:020703E80203><hex:022402DA03> minutes past the hour (Earth Time):<hex:02100103>Leap of Faith, The Slice Is Right, and Air Force One (The Cieldalaes).

39.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_GATE_1_1
39.description: The stage is set: high atop a lofty locale, a wayward chocobo chick with a wont for wanderlust chirps out in distress. Are you adventurer enough to brave the heights and rescue the frightened hatchling from its feather-raising plight!?

40.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_GATE_1_2
40.description: Should you wish to participate in Cliffhanger, keep your eyes open for a concerned chocobo aficionado in Round or Wonder Square. You never know when a panicked “kweh” will ring out from the heavens...

41.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_GATE_2_1
41.description: En route to the Gold Saucer: a shipment of priceless Thorne Dynasty vases. The Jolly Raptor has been entrusted with the delivery, but the shipping conglomerate has reason to believe that a band of unscrupulous brigands has set their sights on the cargo.

42.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_GATE_2_2
42.description: Are you stealthy and surreptitious enough to deliver the goods to their destination while steering clear of the bandits' greedy gaze? The Jolly Raptor could use a few good <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D656EFF046D656E03>!

43.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_GATE_3_1
43.description: Imps, imps, everywhere! With the Gold Saucer suffering from an imp infestation, the management recruited a contingent of adventurers to purge the voidsent pests...

44.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_GATE_3_2
44.description: ...Only to see the imps transform themselves into the spitting images of their would-be hunters and dash off into the crowds! Can you identify friend from foe quickly enough to put an end to the two-faced threat!?

45.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_GATE_4_1
45.description: Do you dance a mean Manderville? Is your bomb dance positively explosive? At the Gold Saucer, we are ever looking to shine the spotlight on the finest young dancers in Eorzea!

46.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_GATE_4_2
46.description: Prove yourself on the grand stage and it just might be your first step into Ul'dahn high society. Some of the sultanate's preeminent choreographists are known to frequent Event Square─don't hesitate to show them your moves!

47.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_GATE_5_1
47.description: The mission statement of our founder, Godbert Manderville, states that all are welcome to seek employment at the Gold Saucer, regardless of race, nation, or creed. We even welcomed to our ranks a kindly voidsent who joined us after an aborted gladiatorial career.

48.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_GATE_5_2
48.description: Typhon is his name, and it would appear the air in Eorzea does not agree with him, as his tempestuous sneezes are truly a sight to behold. If you believe you can hold steady against his gale-force nasal eruptions, seek out the thaumaturge in Event Square!

49.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_GATE_7_1
49.description: There is nowhere to go but up in this grueling test of acrobatic prowess. If you believe yourself sure of foot and strong of will, we invite you to try and overcome the dizzying heights of this death-defying attraction.

50.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_GATE_7_2
50.description: When the course is ready, you will find a sabotender in Round Square awaiting any would-be challengers.

51.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_GATE_8_1
51.description: Have you the eye of an eagle? Aim as true as a mother's love for her babe? Then perhaps it is <hex:021A020203>high<hex:021A020103> time you took to the skies in search of true adventure! Air Force One will test your both your skills and your belly...just <hex:021A020203>do<hex:021A020103> take care not to part company with its contents o'er the railing!

52.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_GATE_8_2
52.description: When the course is ready, you will find a sabotender in Round Square awaiting any would-be challengers.

53.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_GATE_9_1
53.description: Have you a natural aversion to being crushed by falling bamboo, or trampled by gold-loving hounds? If so, The Slice Is Right is the perfect attraction for you. The longer you survive, the greater the rewards, though you will have to contend with the fearsome Yojimbo!

54.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_GATE_9_2
54.description: Should you wish to take part, make your way to Event Square and speak with the oddly dressed attendant to take part, providing that you have adequately steeled yourself beforehand, that is.

55.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_LOVM
55.description: The Lord of Verminion tables can be found in Minion Square─simply take the lift, and follow the exultant cries and anguished wails of the combatants.

56.name: TEXT_CMNGSCESTABLISHMENTGUIDANCE_00241_LOVM_001
56.description: If you wish to pit your minion collection against other would-be generals in a fierce contest of strategy and strength, then Lord of Verminion is the game for you!
